fusions.name: Words Choked Off
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Sends a jet of musk into the mouth of the first enemy within 7 tiles that deals 6 damage and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Silenced Mid-Word
fusions.desc: A burst of musk deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns each for 1 second and leaves it [Stalled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Practiced Cadence
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 30% for 15 seconds. A haze of musk fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rote Habit
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. You have 10% poison resistance.
